title: Chapter 247
text:
No pop-up window, free to read!

The title of [Shocking! The mastermind behind the war is actually …] was uploaded to the Blue Star forum, and it was pinned to the top immediately.

During this period of time, the Blue Star players' attention was attracted by the war, and they personally participated in a war that would change the structure of the world. They deeply felt that their words and actions affected the situation of the war, and it was very immersive. However, at this juncture, this post revealed the inside story. It turned out that there was a mastermind behind the war, Zero, who added fuel to the fire and caused the war single-handedly.

Some players had already seen the bounty list, and they immediately remembered that Zero was a traitor with a high bounty on his head. They were very curious about this person.

A traitor turning the tables and severely damaging the original organization — this kind of drama sounded like a legend!

Starting the war secretly, he was definitely a key character in the main storyline!

The post introduced Zero's deeds from the perspective of the Germinal Organization, and the players were amazed. They thought that the introduction was over, but they did not expect that there would be more content after that, and it also introduced Black Phantom's deeds. No special explanation was given, but for some reason, this was also included. The players patiently read on, and it would be good to know more about Black Phantom.

However, when it came to the last part, the players' expressions changed.

No matter if it was Black Phantom or Zero, they were the same person!

"What does this mean?"

"Black Phantom and Zero are actually the same person?"

The players subconsciously doubted the authenticity of the post, but the post also included the video of Han Xiao causing trouble at the Germinal Organization headquarters, and it was solid evidence. Seeing was believing, and the players were shocked.

The players were not familiar with Zero, but Black Phantom was an old acquaintance. From the start of the open beta until now, he had given them a lot of benefits and frequently interacted with them. When they saw him attacking the Germinal Organization headquarters, they actually felt that it was normal and reasonable. This was a sense of recognition that came automatically after they became familiar with this person, just like when they saw Master Kui killing God, they felt that this was how it should be.

Now, his identity was finally exposed.

He was Zero, and he was also Black Phantom.

His name was Han Xiao!

With the combination of the two identities, Zero's deeds completed the image of Black Phantom, and it suddenly became more complete. In the minds of the players, there was a fugitive who had struggled to escape from the Germinal Organization's control for freedom. His miserable life and desperate situation did not defeat him. He slowly grew up and became a super powerful figure. He secretly dealt with the organization that had caused the disaster to him and started a war that swept across the world. It was like an American blockbuster legend.

The market for individual heroism was always very popular. Han Xiao's status in the hearts of the players rose again. One look and they could tell that he was the main character of the planet, and the Germinal Organization was the villain. Although there was no right or wrong in the world, people were used to making things easier to judge. Polarization was easier than diversity. The players did not care about the ideals of the Germinal Organization. They were used to standing in the position of people they were familiar with. The image that Han Xiao created was equivalent to 'one of their own' in their eyes.

This post suddenly became a hot topic. Counting Han Xiao's past and present life in detail, the Blue Star players felt like they were witnessing history and a legend. Tens of thousands of posts were added in an instant, and it was still increasing at a rate of hundreds of posts per second. On the official forum's hot topic list, it instantly soared to the top ten, and the popularity index was increasing every second.

Just as Han Xiao expected, the combination of the two identities brought a chemical reaction that pushed his popularity to a new peak, and the impact continued to ferment, establishing his reputation and position in the hearts of the players.

He had been making his presence known since the open beta, and he had laid the foundation for his current elevation. It was like accumulating a pile of dry firewood, and now that a little spark had been added, it finally turned into a blazing flame, and it was burning brightly.

The players were the first group to know about the first-hand information on the forum. At this time, Han Xiao and the other two had only escaped from the Germinal Organization headquarters for half an hour.

…

Under the dark night sky, the off-road vehicle drifted across the barren land like a wild dog that was about to take flight. The towering and ferocious headquarters were far behind them.

Han Xiao, who was in the driver's seat, had not taken off his mechanical suit, but he opened his mouth mask. With a cigarette in his mouth, he exuded a strong sense of familiarity. Hella, who was in the passenger seat beside him, was expressionless. The veins on her fair hand that was holding the armrest were bulging.
